says: From the host launcher in a bound repository, the entry shows concrete names and values: the repository and branch, the selected instructions source AGENTS.md, the unselected knowledge source, the suggested tool 'Claude Code 2.1.278 · 새 세션' marked as a suggestion with its model-call effect, a blocker for the unqualified personal decision route that names why and how to fix it, and one start action whose file-change, model-call and permission effects sit on the action itself. The person presses Tab and Enter (surface.drive): the single Enter dispatches exactly one request, with no preview, confirm or extra view between, and the call it makes is preparation.compose — the owner check — for a session start that declares session.routing.activate and carries no work_request, so no business intent is inferred from the launcher. route.select records the start route, selected in the launcher's own repository scope, and answers for that request with the preparation. Negative: selecting the unqualified decision route is answered by its owner as refused with capability_not_qualified and an unsupported route outcome, never run; a selection carrying only a focused route is refused at admission (missing_field /selected); and no frame shows a generic effect panel or confirmation view.
